Chapter 799: Chapter 15 Void Creatures (Subscribe Please)_3

Other Evil Gods realized that the Tianqing World was not easy to provoke, but despite their inability to defeat it, taking a mere glance was extremely normal.

However, Lin Yuan now keenly noticed that even those prying eyes had vanished without a trace.

“What a pity…” Lin Yuan felt somewhat regretful.

He had originally planned to enhance his strength to the limit and then send out his two Primordial Spirits to sweep through the adversaries.

Having killed the Black Demon Pavilion Master and four other powerful Evil Gods, Lin Yuan tasted the sweetness of victory, and though the other Evil Gods might not be as affluent as them, they were at least better than nothing.

“Is it related to the Lord of the Three Yin?”

...

Lin Yuan guessed in his mind that only the high and mighty Lord of the Three Yin, remembered by the Black Demon Pavilion Master, could command so many Evil Gods at once.

“Now, it’s time to properly enhance the Tianqing World.”

Lin Yuan slowly stood up. For over a month, he had devoted most of his energy and attention to comprehending the ‘World’ Divine Ability Imprint and the Spatio-temporal Fusion Rule.

As time passed, Lin Yuan increasingly felt the limitations the Tianqing World imposed on him.

As the master of the World, the Tianqing World could not possibly repel Lin Yuan, but there was a huge disparity between their levels.

Especially as his Inner World reached a dimension of 2.3 billion square miles.

It was like the relationship between a sword and its sheath.

The sword, just with its sharpness and aura, could easily tear the sheath apart.

They didn’t quite match.

“With my current comprehension of the World’s essence, enhancing the level of Tianqing World should not be difficult,” Lin Yuan silently thought.

Now that Tianqing World had become his backyard and his stronghold, elevating its level would allow it to accommodate more Martial Dao Cultivators.

And Lin Yuan would also feel more comfortable within it.

There were only advantages and no disadvantages.

“Martial Ancestor.”

“Greetings, Martial Ancestor.”

As soon as Lin Yuan stepped out of the Martial Hall, the High Priest Qingyao and other Elders of the Tianqing World bowed respectfully to him.

“Hmm.”

Lin Yuan nodded and calmly said, “I will be elevating the world level next. Pay attention during the process.”

Before the echo of his words faded,

Lin Yuan disappeared from the spot.

In the high skies of Tianqing World.

Here, space twisted as Lin Yuan stood tall, overlooking the entire Tianqing World.

From this perspective, the diameter of the Tianqing World exceeded one billion miles, seemingly vast, but clearly a bit cramped for a Tenth Rank Summit life form like Lin Yuan.

“Expand, expand, expand.”

With a single thought from Lin Yuan, the Origin Source of the entire Tianqing World suddenly boiled and began to massively absorb the energy from the Boundless Void.

The limitless power, which even Evil Gods couldn’t directly absorb, rushed into Tianqing World, causing it to rapidly expand. The land stretched, the oceans widened, and deeper in the oceans, new lands were born.

During the proactive guidance to elevate the World’s level, Lin Yuan gained a lot as well; with every expansion of Tianqing World, his understanding deepened.

[Your comprehension is extraordinary, leading the expansion of the World, enhancing your grasp on the essence of the World…]

…

In just a few days, Lin Yuan’s comprehension of the ‘World’ Divine Ability Imprint increased by one-tenth, a progress that would normally take decades under regular contemplation.

“Now it’s about right.”

Lin Yuan slowly ceased his contemplation, looking towards the Tianqing World that had expanded tenfold.

“Huh?”

“Has the Spatio-temporal Fusion Rule reached the Third Realm?” Lin Yuan raised an eyebrow.

Before attempting his tenth traversal, Lin Yuan’s comprehension of the Spatio-temporal Fusion Rule was close to the Peak of the Second Realm.

Now, by actively guiding the expansion of the Tianqing World, he had advanced the Spatio-temporal Fusion Rule into the Third Realm.

“It’s a pity, even Worlds have their limits.”

Lin Yuan sighed inwardly. Tianqing World managed to expand tenfold in just a few days mainly due to the accumulation over hundreds of thousands of years under the ‘management’ of the Ancestral Demon Tree and its constant slow enhancement up until now, finally bursting forth.

It was also related to Lin Yuan’s own realm, his understanding of the ‘World’ Divine Skills, and his comprehensive insight into the Spatio-temporal Fusion Rule and numerous other Fusion Rules, which were all integrated into Tianqing World.

Following this.

For Tianqing World to continue expanding, Lin Yuan’s realm needed to improve further, along with a certain level of inherent accumulation.

Anyway, it was not something that could be achieved in a short time.

…

Outside the Martial Hall.

The High Priest Qingyao and many of the Tianqing World Elders had witnessed the entire process of the World’s transition.

“The World… The World has changed…”

“The sky has risen, the earth has thickened, and the space has become more vast.”

The many Elders swallowed nervously. Even though they had long regarded the Martial Ancestor as their ultimate faith, their hearts were still overwhelmed by the shock when they witnessed this scene for themselves.

…

After elevating the level of the Tianqing World,

Lin Yuan returned once more to the depths of the Martial Hall.

“Now, it feels much more comfortable.” Lin Yuan’s face wore a smile, for the Tianqing World could now at least accommodate him.

Indeed, for Lin Yuan, the Boundless Void was more suitable, but as the ‘Heavenly Tao’ of the Tianqing World, being within the Tianqing World was the safest for Lin Yuan.

With the support of the World’s Origin Source from the Tianqing World, Lin Yuan’s combat power was at its strongest.

“You go to that Void Secret Realm.”

Lin Yuan looked towards the Taiyang Divine Spirit, took out the ‘Scroll’, and handed it over.

Now that the two Primordial Spirits had completely absorbed the liquid inside the Mysterious Gourd, reaching their peak level, they were ready to be dispatched.

The Void Secret Realm was highly valued by Lin Yuan, hence he sent the Taiyang Divine Spirit there first to see what was unique about it.

“As for you, go and seek more Worlds, spreading Martial Tao.” Lin Yuan looked towards the Taiyin Primordial Spirit, the Boundless Void, filled with myriad Worlds.

And these Worlds were Lin Yuan’s best targets for disseminating Martial Tao.

Besides, while searching for more Worlds, the Taiyin Primordial Spirit could also hunt some Evil Gods for research purposes.

As for Lin Yuan himself, naturally, he stayed to oversee the Tianqing World, commanding everything.
